Travel Notice for Companion Animal Guests

Travelers should know that Aurelia Skyways will continue to support companion animals with careful attention from booking through pickup. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is here to help make each step smoother for pets and their people.

Please keep travel documents ready and make sure carriers are clean, secure, and suited to the animal traveling. If your pet needs special handling, let the desk know as early as possible so the team can review the plan and coordinate care with the rest of the journey. Small details matter, and early contact helps reduce stress for everyone involved.

During busy periods, desk staff may focus first on safety checks, handoff notes, and follow-up care, so travelers should allow extra room in their plans for routine review. If you are bringing a pet with an unsettled temperament, or if there are changes to feeding, comfort, or pickup needs, share that information clearly before departure. The team will work to keep communication simple and calm.

Please visit the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help with pet travel arrangements, arrival support, and any needed updates.
